rounds.proof_sketch: The mutation is in the template specialization `softsign_kernel<half>` (line 21-26). The input specification fixes dtype=torch.float32. AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES_AND_HALF dispatches to the generic template `softsign_kernel<T>` where T=float for float32 inputs. The mutated half-precision kernel is never instantiated or executed for float32 inputs.
rounds.survival_reason: The mutation changes `blockDim.x` to `blockDim.y` in the half-precision (float16) kernel specialization only. With the fixed input specification of dtype=torch.float32, the CUDA dispatch macro AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES_AND_HALF selects the generic template `softsign_kernel<scalar_t>` where scalar_t=float, NOT the specialized `softsign_kernel<half>`. The mutated code path is therefore completely unreachable under the given test contract. The original generic template for float/double types (lines 12-18) remains unchanged and computes correct indices using `blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x`. No float32 input, regardless of its numerical values, can trigger execution of the mutated half-precision kernel.
rounds.kill_strategy: This mutant is unkillable under the fixed dtype=torch.float32 contract. The mutation only affects the float16 (half) kernel specialization which is never invoked for float32 inputs. To kill this mutant would require changing the input dtype to torch.float16, which violates the fixed-shape/dtype contract. If float16 inputs were allowed, any input with more than 256 elements would expose the bug since blockDim.y=1 vs blockDim.x=256 produces completely wrong index calculations for blockIdx.x > 0.
rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing frameworks should explicitly test all dtype paths that a kernel supports. When a kernel has template specializations for different dtypes (float, double, half), the test suite should include inputs of each dtype to ensure mutations in type-specific code paths are reachable. Additionally, consider adding compile-time assertions or static analysis to flag mutations in dead code paths relative to the test contract.
